translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Luzitisa Yave !
Lusakumunu kuidi mutu wowo weti kinzika Yave ;
wowo weti mona khini mu zithumunu ziandi.
Bana bandi bela ba lulendo va ntoto ;
Tsungi yi batu balulama yela sakumunu.
Bima biwombo ayi kimvuama bidi mu nzo andi
ayi busonga buandi bunzingilanga mu zithangu zioso.
Ka diambu ko mu tombi, kiezila kieti kienzuka mu diambu di batu balulama mu mintima ;
mu diambu di nkua nlemvo ayi nkua kiadi ayi mutu wusonga.
Mamboti mela kuiza kuidi mutu wowo wunkabulanga mu luzolo
ayi wundevisanga mu kambu kuiku ;
ayi wundiatisanga bisalu biandi mu busonga.
Bukiedika kalendi nikuka ko ;
mutu wusonga wela tebukulungu moyo mu zithangu zioso.
Kalendi mona zitsangu zimbimbi tsisi ko.
Ntimꞌandi widi wukinda, wuntulanga diana mu Yave.
Ntimꞌandi widi mu luvovomo, kalendi mona tsisi ko
ku tsuka wela nunga mu tala batu bobo beti kunlenda.
Wunkabulanga mu zindambu zioso makaba mu diambu di nsukami ;
busonga buandi bunzingilanga mu zithangu zioso ;
phokꞌandi yela vumbulu ngolo mu nzitusu.
Mutu wumbimbi wela bumona ayi wela fuema ;
wela kueta meno ayi wela lalakana.
Zikhanu zi mutu wumbimbi ziela kituka ziphamba.
